metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Distance traveled
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in center
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the center.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in center)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in open arms
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in an open arm.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in open arms)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in closed arms
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in a closed arm.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in closed arms)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Open arm time ratio
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in open arms.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Closed arm time ratio
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in closed arms.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Open arm entries
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Closed arm entries
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Latency to open arm
metrics.definition: Time of the first tracked sample inside the zone, from the trial start.
metrics.formula: first tracked sample time in open arms
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no tracked sample is inside the zone; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Risk assessments
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when risk assessment was not scored.
